subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is not under the rocks, causing Zalthir to think they have not lost the guide.
source_quote: Zalthir notices that Sarith is not under the rocks and thinks, “We have not lost the guide.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin reaches for Grygum, prompting Zalthir to think they need the healer.
source_quote: He sees Thorin reach for Grygum and thinks, “We need the healer.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is injured and unconscious but alive.
source_quote: Daz is injured and unconcious but alive.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum tells the frightened Myconid child to go help Shuushar.
source_quote: Gyrgum tells the frightened Myconid child, “Go help Shuushar.”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido shouts that the divine plan said Sarith would rescue him.
source_quote: Buppido shouts, “The divine plan said you would rescue me, Sarith!”

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: A massive, ghastly insect with bulbous shape and clicking legs leaves behind exhumed remains.
source_quote: In the darkness, something shifts, legs clicking. Zalthir sees the bulbous shape of a massive, ghastly insect leaving behind a meal of exhumed remains.

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature clicks its mandibles and probes with feather-like feelers.
source_quote: The thing clicks its mandibles, feather-like feelers probing the darkness for its next meal.

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature screeches and emits a smell of rot and loam.
source_quote: It screeches, and the smell of rot and loam overwhelms him.

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature wraps its entire staggering length around Zalthir.
source_quote: Before the centipede-like creature wraps its entire, staggering length around him,

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature wraps its tentacle around Grygum, knocking him out.
source_quote: So, the creature wraps its tentacle around Grygum, knocking him out.

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature attempts to avoid getting hurt by exposing its soft, fleshy parts to bolts.
source_quote: the beast, which, in its attempt to avoid gEttin g hurt, exposes its soft, fleshy parts to more bolts.

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature bites Thorin.
source_quote: The enraged monster bites Thorin,

subject: centipede-like creature
fact: The centipede-like creature tries to grapple Sarith with its mandible and fails.
source_quote: He then tries to grapple Sarith with his mandible and fails.

subject: killing the centipede-like creature
fact: Buppido and Sarith kill the creature with their bolts.
source_quote: Buppido and Sarith kill the creature with their bolts.

subject: Sarith shouting for rations
fact: Sarith shouts, “Rations!”
source_quote: And then Sarith shouts, “Rations!”

subject: Zalthir waking Daz and Grygum
fact: Zalthir wakes up Daz and Grygum.
source_quote: Zalthir wakes up Daz and Grygum.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz mutters that Thorin’s decision may cause traveling companions to choose to help.
source_quote: When Daz hears about Thorin’s decision, he mutters, “Good decision. Maybe, just maybe, our traveling companions will see our actions and choose to help.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz tells Zalthir an hour later, “Did you notice that?”
source_quote: An hour later,  Daz tells Zalthir, “Did you notice that?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thinks they are being followed and hears the careful footsteps of a drow scout.
source_quote: Daz thinks, “We are being followed.” He hears the careful footsteps of a drow scout, a sound he is very familiar with.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz identifies the footsteps as Drow.
source_quote: He turns to Zalthir, “Drow.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir remembers the particular gait of the Drow soldier Nym.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers the particular gait of one of the Drow soldiers, Nym, and mutters, “It’s the Drow from Velkynvelve. These are their scouts.”

subject: Nym
fact: Nym is a Drow soldier from Velkynvelve.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers the particular gait of one of the Drow soldiers, Nym, and mutters, “It’s the Drow from Velkynvelve. These are their scouts.”

subject: Korrh Erann
fact: Korrh Erann was a monk of Zalthir’s order who was pursued by Drow in the Underdark.
source_quote: Zalthir remembers reading the story of one of the monks of his order who was trapped in the Underdark and pursued by Drow. The monk, Korrh Erann, had been part of a group pursued for days.

subject: Korrh Erann
fact: Korrh Erann insisted that killing Drow scouts was a dangerous gamble and chose to run.
source_quote: Korrh insisted that this was a dangerous gamble and chose to run.

subject: Korrh Erann
fact: Korrh Erann was the only survivor of his group pursued by Drow.
source_quote: He was the only survivor.

subject: Zalthir shouting to run
fact: Zalthir shouts, “We have to run!”
source_quote: Zalthir, remembering the story, shouts, “We have to run!”

subject: Thorin offering to carry Stool
fact: Thorin shouts, “Get on my back!”
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “Get on my back!”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool jumps on Thorin’s back and releases his rapport spores.
source_quote: Stool jumps on and releases his rapport spores.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool asks if releasing rapport spores was a good idea.
source_quote: A few moments later, he asks everyone, “Was that a good idea? I think it was a good idea.”

subject: Stool
fact: Stool says he is glad everyone liked his good idea.
source_quote: Before anyone can respond, he says, “I’m really glad you liked my good idea!”

subject: Zalthir running ahead
fact: Zalthir dashes off ahead using his monk training to speed ahead.
source_quote: Zalthir dashes off ahead, using his monk training to speed ahead.

subject: tunnel veering left
fact: Zalthir chooses the tunnel veering left as a path to escape.
source_quote: He sees a tunnel and chooses the one veering left.

subject: space behind stalagmites
fact: Zalthir notices a space behind some stalagmites that the group can hide behind.
source_quote: he notices a space behind some stalagmites that they could hide behind.

subject: group running to hiding space
fact: Thorin, Daz, Grygum, and the remaining prisoners run to the hiding space.
source_quote: Thorin, Daz,  Grygum, and the remaining prisoners run to the hiding space.

subject: Drow scouts sprinting
fact: The pursuing Drow start sprinting in their haste.
source_quote: the pursuing Drow, hearing the running, start sprinting

subject: Drow scouts avoiding a drop
fact: The Drow scouts barely avoid a sudden drop in the cave tunnels.
source_quote: in their haste, barely avoid a sudden drop in the cave tunnels.

subject: Zalthir falling from hiding
fact: Zalthir has fallen from his hiding place behind the stalagmites.
source_quote: Zalthir has fallen from his hiding place.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym draws his weapon upon seeing Zalthir fall.
source_quote: Nym draws his weapon.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym feels a tremor and worries the cave will collapse.
source_quote: Then, he feels a tremor. Worried that this cave will collapse

subject: Nym
fact: Nym turns to leave because he sees no evidence of the prisoners.
source_quote: and seeing no evidence of the prisoners, he turns to leave.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym mutters, “I told you it was the other tunnel.”
source_quote: As they leave, Nym mutters, “I told you it was the other tunnel.”

subject: Grygum’s Thaumaturgy causing tremor
fact: Grygum’s Thaumaturgy was the source of the tremor Nym felt.
source_quote: What Nym didn’t know was that Grygum’s Thaumaturgy was the source of the tremor.

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir whispers that Ilvara has found them and caught up with them.
source_quote: Sathir whispers in their skulls, “Ilvara has found us and, worse, has caught up with us.”

subject: Sathir
fact: Sathir says they must put distance between themselves and Ilvara or have someone cover their trail.
source_quote: We must put some distance between us and them. Or we can keep going slowly and have someone cover our trail.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin whispers that he was taught to cover tracks in the Underdark.
source_quote: The dwarf whispers, “I was taught to cover our tracks in the Underdark.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asks where the drow are — ahead or behind.
source_quote: Grygum asks, “Where are the drow? Are they ahead of us? Behind us?”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith mutters that overbriters that cannot fly are the easiest prey in the Underdark.
source_quote: Sarith mutters, “Overbriters that cannot fly are the easiest prey in the Underdark.”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith explains that the Underdark is not flat and tunnels twist, turn, and change.
source_quote: The Underdark is not flat. And the tunnels don’t move in a straight line. They twist, and they turn. Worse, the tunnel system is constantly changing.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith says an enemy can appear far away then suddenly in front of you.
source_quote: And so an enemy can appear far away, only to appear in front of you.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith says what’s important is to move and hope no tunnel gives the enemy a shortcut.
source_quote: What’s important is that we move. And we hope no tunnel gives them a shortcut to find us.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thinks the Underdark is like a maze.
source_quote: Grygum thinks, “Like a Maze?”

subject: Drow soldier
fact: The Drow soldier nods in agreement that the Underdark is like a maze.
source_quote: The Drow soldier nods.
